title: Protocol for sorting and culturing of mouse early erythroid progenitor BFU-E cells
protocol: Sacrifice a pregnant mouse at 13.5 days gestation.
Place the fetuses in one tube for further isolation.
Dissect the uterus from the pregnant mouse.
Use fine tipped forceps to tear the uterus and squeeze out the fetuses.
Wash the fetuses once in PBS and place them in a new culture dish.
Remove connective tissues surrounding the fetal liver and put it into a 15 mL tube.
Dissociate fetal liver cells by pipetting with 4 mL PBS-BSA to generate a single cell suspension.
Pass the cell suspension through a 30 μm pre-strainer into a new 15 mL tube.
Count the cells and centrifuge for 5 min at 300 × g at 4°C.
Adjust the cell concentration of fetal liver cells to 100 × 10^6 cells/mL with PBS-BSA in a 1.5 mL tube.
Add 0.2 μg of each antibody from the biotin anti-mouse lineage panel per million cells and incubate at 4°C for 15 min.
Wash off unbound antibodies with 1X PBS and centrifuge for 5 min at 300 × g at 4°C.
Resuspend cells in 500 μL PBS-BSA, add 2 μL streptavidin microbeads per million cells, and incubate at 4°C for 30 min.
Pass the labeled fetal liver cells through an LS column according to manufacturer's instructions.
Collect Lin- cells and centrifuge.
Adjust cell concentration of collected Lin- cells to 100 × 10^6 cells/mL for the second round of magnetic cell sorting.
Incubate Lin- cells with 0.2 μg of each antibody from biotin anti-mouse CD34, biotin anti-mouse CD41, biotin anti-mouse Sca-1, and biotin anti-mouse CD16/32 per million cells for 15 min at 4°C.
Wash off unbound antibodies with 1X PBS.
Add 2 μL streptavidin microbeads per million cells and incubate at 4°C for 30 min.
Pass the labeled fetal liver cells through the LS column according to manufacturer’s instructions.
Collect Lin-CD34-CD41-CD16/32-Sca1- cells after passing through the LS column.
Count collected cells and centrifuge 5 minutes at 300 × g at 4°C.
Resuspend cells with 400 μL PBS-BSA.
Assemble 0.2 μg of each antibody per million cells: APC anti-mouse c-Kit (CD117), PE anti-Streptavidin, and PE/Cy7 anti-mouse CD71.
Harvest 2 × 10^5 cells in 100 μL PBS-BSA.
Add each antibody individually to separate tubes.
Incubate antibodies and cells in the dark at 4°C for 15–20 minutes.
Centrifuge 5 minutes at 300 × g at 4°C.
Wash off unbound antibody with 1 mL PBS.
Collect cells by centrifuging 5 minutes at 300 × g at 4°C.
Resuspend cells with 2 mL PBS for cell sorting.
Store cells in 0.5% BSA-PBS solution at 4°C when preparing the sorter.
Set voltage and regulate compensation of PE, PE/Cy7, and APC fluorescence using single stain control.
Exclude cell debris and dead cells according to SSC and FSC.
Take PE-streptavidin negative cells as gate 1.
Sort BFU-E cells from Kit+ fraction according to CD71 expression (10% lowest CD71 expression part).
Plate sorted BFU-E cells in expansion media at a concentration of 0.25–1 × 10^6 cells/mL in a 6-well plate.
Culture cells in the optimal concentration range (0.25–1 × 10^6 cells/mL) using fresh expansion media.
Maintain cell cultures at 37°C and 5% CO2 in a sterile cell culture incubator.
